page.overview:
Who is Agravaine?

Sir Agravaine was a knight and a member of the Knights of the Round Table. He was a nephew of King Arthur.

Sir Agravaine was one of the possible answers on Sophronia Franklin's history quiz regarding who defeated Emeric the Evil in a duel.
